title: Europe is back: How VW, Stellantis and Co. shine in Paris
summary: The Paris Motor Show is a magnet for the global automotive industry this week. Europe’s sector is making it clear at the industry event that it will not cede the electric vehicle field to China without a fight. Above all, Stellantis and VW are presenting numerous innovations. Here’s our live trade fair report from Paris.

title: Aito plans European expansion for autumn 2027
summary: The Chinese Seres brand Aito outlines its launch plans for Europe at the Paris Motor Show: In autumn 2027, the EV manufacturer intends to enter the European market. In Paris, the luxury automaker is already presenting the quartet Aito 9, Aito 8, Aito 7, and Aito 6.

title: Škoda introduces Epiq Sportline with Up to 440 km range
summary: Skoda is expanding the Epiq lineup with a Sportline version that will be available in Germany as the Epiq 40 and Epiq 55, offering up to 155 kW of power and a range of 440 kilometers. Orders are set to open at the end of October.

title: Electric motorcycle breaks world record with 436.5 kms without stopping
summary: A Zero DS covered 436.5 kilometers on a single battery charge. According to the company, Zero Motorcycles is now the new Guinness World Record holder for the longest ride without a charging stop on an electric motorcycle.

title: World premiere for the Lancia Gamma at the Paris Motor Show
summary: Lancia is using the 2026 Paris Motor Show to unveil its new compact SUV, the Gamma. In addition to a petrol version, there will be three electric variants, including an HF Integrale—though not in Germany. The Lancia Gamma will remain unavailable in the German market for the foreseeable future.

title: TomTom accelerates integration of new EVs into its EV services
summary: TomTom is expanding its E-Mobility Suite with a new platform for automakers. With "Electric Vehicle Management," new EV variants are to be integrated into routing, range calculation, and charging planning within minutes instead of months.

title: GBT begins series production of solid-state battery cells
summary: Greater Bay Technology, a Chinese battery developer supported by the GAC Group, has started series production of solid-state battery cells in Guangzhou. Production is taking place on a converted lithium-ion line with an initial capacity of 1 GWh, which can be expanded to up to 4 GWh.

title: Rhenus deploys 51 Mercedes eSprinter vans for last-mile delivery
summary: Rhenus expands its electric fleet with 51 Mercedes-Benz eSprinter. The vans, equipped with 81-kWh batteries and box bodies by Junge Fahrzeugbau, will be deployed nationwide for home delivery services.

title: Daimler Buses edges closer to the battery-electric coach with its ELCH Project
summary: The partners in the Electrified Coach (ELCH) funding project have reached a milestone: When the team led by Daimler Buses met in the German district of Neu-Ulm, they conducted a test drive with the jointly developed technology demonstrator that can travel more than 500 kilometers. The funding project will continue until the end of 2026.

title: Renault 4 update includes a €1,810 price reduction
summary: The Renault 4 E-Tech electric follows in the footsteps of its sibling, the Renault 5, and now also benefits from an update. From now on, it offers more range, improved equipment in detail, and a lower price. Additionally, Renault introduces the special edition "Roland-Garros". We explain where the unique features lie.

title: Trafigura secures access to lithium from EnergyX
summary: Commodity trader Trafigura has signed a binding 10-year offtake agreement with EnergyX for 100,000 tonnes of battery-grade lithium products from its projects in the USA and Chile. A significant portion of the lithium is to be supplied to US battery plants.

title: BMW invests over €100 million in e-motor production in Steyr
summary: BMW plans to establish state-of-the-art production of power electronics and inverter components at its plant in Austria by 2029. This initiative aims to strengthen the technological expertise of the Steyr plant, increase value creation within the company, and further anchor key know-how for electric mobility in Austria.

title: Switzerland doubles funding budget for commercial truck chargers
summary: Applications for subsidies for truck chargers have been so overwhelming that the Swiss goverment has expanded the funding program for the installation of truck charging infrastructure that was introduced at the beginning of 2026. Initially 20 million Swiss francs (approximately 21.5 million euros) was allocated to support truck electrification, but this amount has now been almost doubled with an additional 20 million Swiss francs released.

title: Michelin launches EV Charge for European fleets
summary: Michelin Connected Fleet has introduced Michelin EV Charge, a new charging solution for corporate fleets. In collaboration with Deftpower, the company is consolidating access to over 1.2 million charging points, billing, and telematics data on a single platform.

title: Chery establishes German headquarters and prepares Chery Q EV market entry
summary: Chery is introducing the Chery Q, its first electric model for EU markets. The 4.19-meter-long electric compact car joins the Chinese carmaker's previously hybrid-focused lineup in Europe. The market launch of the Chery Q in Germany is scheduled for a slightly later date than the company's hybrids.

title: Trump administration lowers US fuel efficiency standards
summary: Under Trump, the US transportation authority has reduced fuel consumption limits for new cars, with implications for both consumers and the environment. In response, 26 US states, counties, and major cities have joined forces and filed a lawsuit. We explore the legal basis and implications of the lawsuit.

title: Family at heart: How Forthing aims for success in Europe
summary: Following its debut at the Paris Motor Show two years ago and a stopover at the Munich IAA, the Chinese manufacturer is making its third major trade fair appearance and showcasing three models that set to hit the road in Europe. Forthing aims to stand out from the competition with a particular focus on family-friendliness. Here's all the key details on the models presented.

title: September: 1.3 million BEVs sold in China
summary: In China, September became a new record month for BEV sales: never before have so many been sold by the country, both domestically and abroad. 1.82 million plug-in vehicles (including hybrids and range extenders) were sold – accounting for over 60 per cent of all new vehicles last month.

title: Mercedes-Benz introduces V2G package for private customers
summary: Mercedes is revealing its V2G ambitions for Germany. After introducing its new V1G home charging tariffs in September, the Stuttgart-based automaker is now launching a bidirectional package that will initially work in Germany with the electric GLC and the new C-Class. The Mobility House is on board as the technology service provider.

title: INIT enters autonomous fleet management market
summary: Karlsruhe-based public transport specialist INIT is acquiring a majority stake in Norwegian technology company Applied Autonomy. Its xFlow platform does not develop autonomous driving itself but organises the monitoring, remote support, and control of autonomous vehicles. The software is already in use in Stavanger.

title: BMW sees BEV deliveries rise in Q3 2026
summary: In the third quarter of this year, the BMW Group delivered 110,257 all-electric cars worldwide - representing a 7.2 per cent increase year-on-year. Sales saw significant growth, particularly in Europe and Germany. However, for the first nine months, the electric vehicle balance sheet still showed a deficit.

title: Tasmania to fund 50 new EV charging points at tourism hotspots
summary: The Australian island state is offering AU$250,000 in grants to help tourism businesses install EV charging points at 24 destinations across the region. This will primarily target overnight AC charging.

title: Tesla extends home backup functions to Model 3 and Model Y in the US
summary: Tesla has extended its Powershare Home Backup function to the Model 3 saloon and Model Y SUV in the US, enabling both BEVs to supply electricity to a home during a power outage. The feature was previously only available on the Cybertruck.

title: Stellantis and Leapmotor: how much Chinese technology will make its way into European cars?
summary: Stellantis and Leapmotor are deepening their collaboration far beyond distribution. Discussions between Danilo Annese, Florian Huettl, Antonio Filosa, and Alain Favey in Paris reveal how tightly production, technology, and development are now interlinked within the group - and where the boundaries still lie.

title: Fraunhofer stabilises aluminium anodes for lithium-ion batteries
summary: The Fraunhofer IPA and the University of Stuttgart have developed a new cell and electrode technology for aluminum anodes. It is intended to make the previously problematic volume changes during charging and discharging manageable, thereby enabling the use of aluminum as an anode material for practical battery applications.

title: Alpine unveils A310 Vision electric sports car concept
summary: Alpine has unveiled the A310 Vision, a one-off design study celebrating 55 years of the original A310 sports car. Presented at the 2026 Paris Motor Show, the design study bridges the gap between the sharp wedge design of the 1970s and the brand's new electric performance platform.

title: ProLogium and Rimac target 2028 for solid-state battery vehicle tests
summary: ProLogium and Rimac Technology are continuing to move forward with their next-gen battery collaboration. At the Paris Motor Show, the partners are initially showcasing a pack mockup; functional hardware and a complete battery pack are expected to follow in 2027, with the first vehicle tests planned for 2028.

title: Xpeng G9L price revealed: luxury eSUV starts at €74,600
summary: Order books have opened for Xpeng's new flagship SUV, the all-electric Xpeng G9L - just in time for its public debut at the Paris Motor Show. The model is being launched simultaneously across 64 countries. In Germany, prices start at €74,600.

title: BYD unveils Atto 8 flagship SUV with nine-minute charging
summary: BYD has unveiled the Atto 8 - a new flagship electric SUV with up to seven seats, a range of over 600 km and a 115 kWh battery. The model is also the first BYD vehicle in Europe to feature the company's new Flash Charging technology, which can charge the battery from 10 to 97 per cent in nine minutes under the manufacturer's stated conditions.

title: Smart #2 now available to pre-order for under €20,000
summary: Earlier this week, the new Smart #2 took centre stage in Paris - and now, the manufacturer has opened pre-orders. The compact electric two-seater can be reserved immediately in four trim lines - with a base price between €19,990 and €25,690.
